_meta.sourceDir: a clean local build, cross-checked line by line against a CI run log
notes: Every metric here is now identical between a local Windows build and the Linux CI build. Confirmed against the deploy.yml log for vault e098001: 442 / 2476 / 183 / 0 / 0 / 0 / 40892 / 85 matched exactly.

'pages' counts DISTINCT CASE-INSENSITIVE routes, not raw .html files. Quartz emits a redirect stub at each note's original-cased path beside the lowercase slug; Linux keeps both (1269 files), Windows collapses each pair (693 files). CI's own listing: 1269 raw = 576 mixed-case stubs + 693 real pages.
That is why an earlier baseline of 1270 looked unreproducible locally and why 693 looked like a 45% drop in CI. Both numbers were correct measurements of different things.
brokenInternalLinks 85 is CI's own figure and matches local exactly. It is a ceiling that must never rise; the links are overwhelmingly into deliberately-unpublished Litteraturlista PDFs.
